{{Template:Top bar|next = Premiere Unlimited '95|previous = Premiere Unlimited '94}} {{Infobox_game |card = Warp Pack |image = Warppack.jpg |imagewidth = 200px |caption = Warp Pack |game = [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]] |expansion = Warp Pack |publisher = [[Decipher]] |country = USA |Card Size = 63x88mm |date = 1994 |language = English |Cards Total = 12}} '''Warp Pack''' is the third expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. This expansion pack was released in May 1995. Available free from Decipher, the 12 white border common cards of the Warp Pack were given out by Decipher as a thank-you to its players and collectors. The cards of the Warp Pack, including "Countermanda" and "Scotty," provide balance to the texture and dimension of the Starter Set cards. Special features include seven common missions and a neutral outpost... just the thing to get players' spacelines jump-started.
